releaseNotes: v1.1.6: Fixes the connection status staying on "connecting" after a hub reboot while the Apple TV was actually connected and working. The status is now corrected on the next health check (within 5 minutes). No Done needed. v1.1.5: Fixes an Apple TV that could stay stuck on "connecting" after a hub reboot or firmware update until Initialize was pressed. A stuck connect now retries on its own within 5 minutes, and logs a warning when it does. No Done needed. v1.1.4: Dark mode. The app follows the hub's light or dark theme (Hubitat 2.5.3+) and keeps its current look on older firmware. No Done needed. Coming in 1.2.0, after more testing: which app is playing on each Apple TV.
author: jdthomas24
tags: Apple TV, TV, video, local control

apps.name: Apple TV Integration
apps.description: Finds Apple TVs on your network, pairs each with the PIN shown on the TV and creates one device per Apple TV.

drivers.name: Apple TV
drivers.description: One per Apple TV. On/off with live power state, playback controls, Siri Remote buttons (including the TV button), volume, app launching and now playing, over an encrypted local connection.
